Texas Senate Race: Polls Show Democrat Leading Republican

Two recent polls indicate that Democratic candidate James Talarico is leading Republican Ken Paxton in the Texas Senate race. This contest is notable because Texas has not elected a Democrat to the U.S. Senate since 1988. Reports suggest Paxton is contending with divisions within the Republican party, low personal approval ratings, and economic concerns.
